label: External character-aligned third person
camera_rules: Keep the camera outside all characters and give it a concrete position relative to visible landmarks.
Let one focal character guide attention, knowledge, and performance emphasis.
Describe external camera movement through start relation, path, speed, subject relation, and landing.
continuity_rules: Preserve axis side, screen direction, eyeline, prop ownership, and state across cuts.
Do not reveal facts unavailable to the focal character unless focalization changes explicitly.
Use only coverage shots that add a distinct visible function.
knowledge_policy: Apply the declared focalization and do not reveal information outside its scope unless the shot plan records a deliberate change.
